category_title: Struggling and reluctant middle school learners in intervention language arts
minimal_context: The student is sitting at combined tables planting flowers and writing thank-you cards for school staff as part of the Sunflower Club.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are working at the combined tables today for the Sunflower Club. Please plant your flowers and write a thank-you card for the school staff.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stares at the blank card) I don't want to write anything.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try to think of a nice sentiment to put on the card.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Whispers to peer) How do you spell 'appreciate'? I don't know how to phrase this.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just do your best to spell it.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pushes the card away) I'm not doing this. My writing is way worse than everyone else's anyway.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: We are working at the combined tables today for the Sunflower Club. Please plant your flowers and write a thank-you card for the school staff.

STUDENT: (Stares at the blank card) I don't want to write anything.

TUTOR: Just try to think of a nice sentiment to put on the card.

STUDENT: (Whispers to peer) How do you spell 'appreciate'? I don't know how to phrase this.

TUTOR: Just do your best to spell it.

STUDENT: (Pushes the card away) I'm not doing this. My writing is way worse than everyone else's anyway.

task.content: Working together at combined tables to plant flowers and write thank-you cards for school staff as part of the 'Sunflower Club' activity.
task.learning_goal: work collaboratively for a common goal

context.social_setting: work collaboratively for a common goal

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When they needed help... how to spell words or how to phrase a sentiment.

behavior_patterns.internal_state: knew their literacy skills were well below those of their peers
